content: {"episode_id":"ep-05070","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration of the denial for CPT 93271 is requested based on recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction. The clinical indication note states that a cardiac event monitor was ordered to evaluate potential arrhythmic causes of these symptoms and assess any correlation between cardiac rhythm disturbances and the patient's neurological history. The provided indication note does not document that less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed insufficient."}
